entrypoint_notes: SKILL.md is a new Vitalis-bound knowledge-only entrypoint, not a copy of the upstream orchestrator. Source Markdown was read as untrusted reference data; no upstream code was executed. Vitalis-local coaching rules support complete conversational plans, recorded-load starting points and existing deterministic API tools without adding bundle tools or writes. Research links and upstream dates are preserved as attribution, not independently verified findings.
excluded_capabilities: independent personal metrics engines and medical prescriptions

safety-boundaries.adaptation_notes: Condensed safety education; red flags precede tools. Applicability is not assumed. No diagnosis or individual progression authority.

evidence-and-uncertainty.adaptation_notes: Retained evidence hierarchy and five upstream public source links; no claim of independent medical verification or personalized evidence engine.

training-principles.adaptation_notes: Condensed domains, general population activity guidance, technique and progression concepts. Vitalis-local additions distinguish completed nominal volume from physiological tolerance, support complete conversational schedules and use recorded loads as adjustable starting points. These additions are local policy, not claims from the pinned upstream. Excluded programming lines 21–33 compiler contracts and automatic execution.

complete conversational plans using recorded loads
day-by-day leg-training and long-run consistency check

technique-and-session-education.adaptation_notes: Retained warm-up, short cues, rest and substitution concepts. Vitalis-local additions allow recorded loads as adjustable starting points, usable set/rep/rest plans, concise RIR guidance and safety questions before relevant risky specifics. These are local coaching policy rather than upstream research or execution authority. Automatic set adjustment and record writing remain excluded.

practical rest ranges and concise RIR explanation

nutrition-education.adaptation_notes: Retained plate, habit and eating-relationship education. Removed personal calorie/protein calculation, trend inference and dietary prescriptions; food example is explicitly hypothetical.

recovery-and-discomfort.adaptation_notes: Retained sleep, recovery and help-seeking education. Removed traffic-light classification, readiness scoring, individual percentage deloads and automatic records.
